answer: A newcomer splits its entry bond through a prism of independent ledge custodians, each holding one fragment and able to slash it if the identity misbehaves. A hollow shell with no real work history cannot pass, because every custodian checks a different fragment of its record. If two identities are caught sharing one funding source, code, or operator, all linked bonds are slashed together, so the nth clone risks every earlier bond and an operator's expected loss grows with the square of n, while one honest agent risks only one bond.
